memberaccess-code-email-subject: Subject line of the email carrying a one-time login code.
memberaccess-code-email-intro: First line of the email carrying a login code, above the code itself.
memberaccess-code-email-validity:
Line below the login code saying how long it lasts. Parameters:
* $1 - the number of minutes the code stays valid
memberaccess-code-email-disclaimer: Closing line of the email carrying a login code, for someone who did not ask for one.
memberaccess-code-email-body:
Plain text alternative of the email carrying a one-time login code, shown by mail clients that do not display the formatted part. Parameters:
* $1 - the login code, in groups of four digits
* $2 - the number of minutes the code stays valid
memberaccess-auth-button-label: Label of the button on the login form that asks for a login code to be mailed to the address above it.
memberaccess-auth-button-help: Help text below the button that asks for a login code to be mailed. "Nothing beyond your email address is requested" is a commitment: keep the meaning "asked for", and do not turn it into "stored".
memberaccess-auth-resend-label: Label of the button on the code entry screen that sends another login code to the same address.
memberaccess-auth-resend-help: Help text under {{msg-mw|Memberaccess-auth-resend-label}}, warning that the previous code stops working.
memberaccess-auth-resend-line:
Offer on the code entry screen to send another code. Parameters:
* $1 - a button labelled {{msg-mw|Memberaccess-auth-resend-label}}, which sends another code
memberaccess-auth-resend-throttled: Replaces {{msg-mw|Memberaccess-auth-resend-line}} on the code entry screen once the throttle will send no more codes, so no offer of another one is shown.
memberaccess-auth-restart: Label of the link back to the start of the login form, shown inside {{msg-mw|Memberaccess-auth-restart-line}}.
memberaccess-auth-restart-line:
Offer on the code entry screen to go back and enter a different address. Parameters:
* $1 - a link labelled {{msg-mw|Memberaccess-auth-restart}}, back to the start of the login form
memberaccess-auth-email-label: Label of the email address field.
memberaccess-auth-email-help: Help text for the email address field.
memberaccess-auth-email-placeholder: Placeholder shown in the email address field on the login form. Follows the wording of {{msg-mw|Userlogin-yourname-ph}} and {{msg-mw|Userlogin-yourpassword-ph}} above it.
memberaccess-auth-form-divider:
Separator between the password login form and the email login section below it on the login form. Kept to a word or two.
{{Identical|Or}}
memberaccess-auth-email-missing: Error shown when a login code is asked for without an email address.
memberaccess-auth-email-invalid: Error shown when the entered email address is malformed.
memberaccess-auth-throttled: Error shown when too many login codes have been asked for. The translation must not reveal whether the address is a member.
memberaccess-auth-code-sent:
Shown after a login code is requested. Names the address back without saying whether it belongs to a member, which is what keeps the answer the same for every address. Parameters:
* $1 - the email address the visitor entered
* $2 - how many minutes the code stays valid
memberaccess-auth-code-label: Label of the login code field.
memberaccess-auth-code-placeholder: Placeholder in the login code field, standing for a code as the email shows one: eight digits in groups of four. Use the digits of the target language where they differ.
memberaccess-auth-code-help: Help text below the login code field. Must not assert that a code was sent.
memberaccess-auth-code-wrong:
Error shown when an entered login code is wrong and attempts remain. Parameters:
* $1 - the email address the code was sent to
* $2 - how many attempts are left
memberaccess-auth-code-missing: Error shown when the code entry form is submitted with an empty code box.
memberaccess-auth-code-outstanding:
Shown on the code entry screen when no new code was sent, so the one already sent is what to enter. Parameters:
* $1 - the email address the code was sent to
memberaccess-auth-code-expired: Error shown when the code is used up, expired, or out of attempts.
memberaccess-auth-not-authorized: Error shown when a correct code was entered but the address is not on the allowlist.
memberaccess-auth-failed: Error shown when a code login cannot continue, for any of several internal reasons. Deliberately vague, so keep the translation unspecific rather than naming a cause.
memberaccess-auth-password-refused: Error shown when setting or resetting the password of a member account is attempted.
memberaccess-api-module-denied:
Action API error shown when a member asks for a query module that lists the wiki's accounts.

Parameters:
* $1 - the name of the query submodule, for example allusers
memberaccess-special-page-denied: Error page shown when a member opens a special page that lists or resolves the wiki's accounts.
memberaccess-block-reason: Reason recorded in the block log when a member is deactivated. Reactivation recognises the extension's own block by this text in the wiki's content language: after a rewording, blocks placed under the old wording are reported as foreign instead of lifted.
memberaccess-unblock-reason: Reason recorded in the block log when a member is reactivated.
memberaccess-opaque-name-reason: Reason recorded in the rename log when the update that gives members opaque usernames renames a member account.
